items.title: Trump demands Arab nations recognise Israel as part of Iran war deal
items.description: Donald Trump has boldly tied negotiations to end his war with Iran to a swathe of Arab nations formally establishing diplomatic ties with Israel.

items.title: More than 20 hospitalised after substance sprayed in Tokyo mall
items.description: The shopping centre, located in the touristy and upmarket shopping district of Ginza, has been blocked off following the incident.

items.title: Iran says 'no tolls' on Strait of Hormuz, but warns everything has a cost
items.description: While on assignment inside Iran, our reporter asked a foreign ministry official about the regime's plan for the Strait of Hormuz. The spokesperson responded that "there is no toll" but also signalled crossing the strait will not be entirely free.

items.title: Document leak at Australia's richest company shows how it put off going green
items.description: Hundreds of pages of internal BHP documents reveal how the company sold itself as a climate leader while internally finding reasons to put off action in the Pilbara.

items.title: Australian astronaut offered place on breakthrough space flight
items.description: The European Space Agency has formally extended the offer for Australia's Katherine Bennell-Pegg to join a mission that would take her to the International Space Station, but the place is not guaranteed.

items.title: ASIO reviewed past terror cases in 2024 but didn't re-examine Bondi attackers
items.description: The head of Australia's domestic intelligence agency reveals it reviewed past terrorism investigations in 2024 which did not extend to a re-examination of the soon to be Bondi gunmen because of a resourcing decision.

items.title: Crews to work overnight after burst pipe in Melbourne leaves thousands without power
items.description: A power company was forced to switch off power to about 10,000 customers in the heart of Melbourne after a burst water main threatened to flood a substation on Monday afternoon.

items.title: Labor calls for spare change as One Nation surges
items.description: Federal Labor is asking for donations to fight One Nation as the latest polling shows the minor party continuing to surge in key electorates, including in Western Sydney.

items.title: 'Fool, ignoramus': Parliamentary committee suspended as senators clash
items.description: A heated exchange prompted a Liberal senator to step in and call point of order on the Labor chair after several insults directed at Nationals senator Bridget McKenzie, before a brief suspension.

items.title: Renewables company destroys Indigenous shelter despite knowing about it
items.description: ACREZ apologises to traditional owners "without reservation" as the NSW Environment Minister Penny Sharpe expresses her "fury" at the incident.

items.title: Iran agreed to give up enriched uranium in US deal, officials say

featured_image.name: Top Iranian official says Tehran would forgo highly enriched uranium in nuclear  deal with Trump

items.description: Two US officials told the New York Times that Iran has agreed in broad terms to give up its stockpile of highly enriched uranium as part of a framework deal announced by President Donald Trump, who declared Saturday that a peace agreement had been "largely negotiated." But a senior Iranian source subsequently told Reuters that Tehran has not agreed to hand over its enriched uranium, highlighting the persistent contradictions between American and Iranian accounts of the deal's terms.[1][2][3][4]

items.title: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negotiated,' Strait of Hormuz to reopen

featured_image.name: Trump gives Iran 48-hour deadline to reopen Strait of Hormuz or face new  strikes

items.description: President Donald Trump declared Saturday that a memorandum of understanding with Iran has been "largely negotiated," with final details to be announced shortly, marking the most concrete step yet toward ending months of conflict between the two nations.

items.title: Trump tells negotiators not to rush Iran deal

featured_image.name: LIVE: Trump instructs negotiators 'not to rush into a deal' with Iran

items.description:
President Donald Trump said on Sunday that he has instructed his negotiators not to "rush into a deal" with Iran, declaring that the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports will "remain in full force and effect" until a final agreement is "reached, certified, and signed."[1][2][3]

The statement came just a day after Trump posted on Truth Social that a memorandum of understanding to end the months-long conflict had been "largely negotiated," raising expectations for an imminent breakthrough.[3][4]

items.title: Iran agrees to surrender enriched uranium as US deal nears, officials say

featured_image.name: Iran Nuclear: Rising IAEA Inspections Can't Fix Deepening Mistrust -  Bloomberg

items.description: President Donald Trump announced Saturday that a peace agreement with Iran has been "largely negotiated," including the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy waterway that has been closed during the conflict between the two nations.

items.title: Ebola patients flee DRC facility after arson as cases near 800

featured_image.name: Ebola Patients Flee After Second Treatment Tent Set on Fire—'Panic'

items.description: The Ebola outbreak tearing through eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has grown to nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, with the disease now spreading across borders into Uganda and prompting emergency declarations from global health authorities.

items.title: Russia fires Oreshnik missile in massive assault on Kyiv

featured_image.name: Russia launched Oreshnik missile at Kyiv Oblast in overnight attack ...

items.description:
Russia unleashed one of its most devastating aerial assaults on Kyiv since the full-scale invasion began, firing 90 missiles and 600 drones at the Ukrainian capital and surrounding areas overnight Sunday, killing at least four people and wounding more than 80, according to Ukrainian officials.[1][2]

Multiple rounds of explosions were heard across the city throughout the early morning hours in a bombardment that lasted more than five hours, damaging residential buildings, schools, markets, and a trade center across the capital.[3][4]

items.title: Zelensky calls Germany's associate EU membership plan 'unfair'

featured_image.name: Exclusive-Ukraine's Zelenskiy says proposal of associate EU ...

items.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told EU leaders in a letter sent late on Friday that a German proposal to grant Ukraine "associate" membership of the European Union was "unfair" because it would leave Kyiv without a voice inside the bloc, according to Reuters, which reviewed the message.[1][2]

"It would be unfair for Ukraine to be present in the European Union, but remain voiceless," Zelensky wrote. "The time is right to move forward with Ukraine's membership in a full and meaningful way."[2][1]

items.title: Taiwan says China deployed 100-plus vessels after Trump-Xi summit

featured_image.name: Chinese military exercises foreshadow a blockade of Taiwan

items.description: Taiwan's National Security Council chief Joseph Wu said Saturday that China has deployed more than 100 navy, coast guard, and other vessels across regional waters in what marks one of Beijing's largest maritime shows of force in recent memory, raising alarm over China's intentions toward the self-governing island.[1][2][3]

items.title: U.S. has 'almost completely excluded' Israel from Iran talks, officials say

featured_image.name: US has almost completely excluded Israel from negotiations with ...

items.description: The United States has "almost completely excluded" Israel from ongoing negotiations with Iran, Israeli defense officials told The New York Times this week, as a widening rift between President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu threatens to reshape Middle Eastern geopolitics.[1]

items.title: Zelensky confirms strike on chemical plant 1,700 km inside Russia

featured_image.name: Ukrainian drones strike Russian chemical giant's plant over 1,700  kilometers from front lines

items.description: Ukraine escalated its long-range drone campaign overnight on May 23, hitting an oil terminal in the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk and a chemical plant nearly 1,700 kilometers from the border, as Kyiv continues to target the energy and industrial infrastructure underpinning Russia's war machine.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].
